title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Supreme Mobiles, headquartered in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, is a leading multi-brand retail chain specializing in mobile phones, accessories, smart gadgets, tablets, laptops, and TVs. Established in 2000 by Managing Director Mr. S. A. Radhakrishnan, the company pioneered a modern retail experience that combines product interaction with convenience and elegance. Supreme Mobiles has grown into the largest mobile retail chain in Western Tamil Nadu, with 75+ stores across 32 cities and a strong reputation as “The Most Trusted Mobile Retailer of Tamilnadu.” The company is committed to genuine products, secure payments, and easy returns, ensuring 100% purchase protection for customers. Supreme Mobiles values teamwork, unity, and a shared vision to serve customers and expand its presence in the consumer electronics market.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Accountant role based at Supreme Mobiles in Tiruppur. The Accountant will handle day-to-day financial transactions, including recording entries, managing accounts payable and receivable, and reconciling bank statements. The role includes preparing financial reports, assisting with budgeting and forecasting, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax regulations. The Accountant will support internal audits, maintain accurate documentation, and collaborate with store and management teams to track revenue, expenses, and inventory-related financial data. The position also involves identifying process improvements, supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, and providing timely financial insights to leadership.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.
* Candidates should possess skills in budget preparation, cost control, and financial analysis to support decision-making in a retail environment.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and ERP tools, as well as solid MS Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of local tax regulations, GST, compliance requirements, and basic audit support practices.
* Candidates should possess attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and strong organizational skills to manage multiple financial tasks and deadlines.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with store teams, management, and external partners.
* Relevant education such as a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications (e.g., CA Intermediate, CMA) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in retail or FMCG accounting, including inventory and sales reconciliation, will be considered beneficial.

title: Procurement Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* 9 Company-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical
**Procurement Analyst**
to support our purchasing operations by analyzing
**procurement data, monitoring supplier performance, and identifying cost-saving opportunities.**
The ideal candidate will have strong
**analytical skills, procurement knowledge, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams**
to drive efficiency and value across the supply chain.
  
  
**What to expect:**
**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Analyze procurement data to identify trends, cost drivers, and opportunities for savings.
* Prepare regular reports on purchasing metrics, supplier performance, and spend analysis.
* Maintain and optimize procurement dashboards, KPIs, and data visualizations.

**Cost Optimization**

* Identify cost-reduction opportunities through spend analysis and supplier consolidation.
* Support negotiations with vendors by providing pricing benchmarks and historical data.
* Track and report realized savings from procurement initiatives.

**Vendor & Supplier Management**

* Evaluate vendor performance using quality, delivery, and cost metrics.
* Support supplier onboarding, audits, and performance reviews.
* Maintain and update the preferred supplier list and contract database.

**Process Improvement & Compliance**

* Support procurement process improvements and standardization across the organization.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, purchasing guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in enforcing contract terms and managing renewal timelines.

**Documentation & Systems**

* Maintain accurate procurement documentation, including purchase orders, contracts, and pricing agreements.
* Work with ERP or procurement systems to extract data, automate reports, and streamline workflows.

**Our new team member will need:**
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, or sourcing.

**Soft Skills:**

* Attention to detail with the ability to manage large data sets.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in procurement or supply chain (e.g., CIPS, CPSM, CSCP).
* Experience in supplier negotiations or contract management.
* Experience working with data centers and/or cloud service providers.

**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
